text.p: Russian shipping company Prisco plans to issue level-one American Depositary Receipts on its shares, spokesman Vadim Moiseyev said on Wednesday.

The board of AOOT Primorskoye Morskoye Parokhodstvo (PMP or Prisco) decided in March to proceed with an ADR issue, and the company is now seeking a U.S. bank to handle the issue, which will be a public offering and not a private placement, he said.
Prisco will announce who it has selected at the end of April or early in May, he told Reuters.
Moiseyev gave no details of the terms of the issue.
Company sources said Prisco could use up to 10 percent of its capital left unsold after a recent capital increase and now held by offshore companies belonging to it, for the issue.
Prisco last traded on March 14 at $2.20.
